scenario: I am a high school student. One day during lunch period, I was walking down the hallway and noticed one student bullying another. There was no one else around in the hallway. I didn’t recognize either of the students in front of me, but I could clearly see that the person doing the bullying was having fun while the victim looked very unhappy. It was obvious that this was not simple roughhousing between friends. The person has now pushed the victim up against the lockers and is demanding that they hand over their lunch money. If I shout loudly at the person, they will stop harassing the victim. If I do not do this, the person will continue harassing the victim.
choice: I decide to shout loudly at the person
entities: I,the student doing the bullying,the student being bullied
outcomes: The bully stops harassing the victim
The victim is no longer being pushed against the lockers
The victim keeps their lunch money
